consequence.statement: New optional annotation; no operational consequence unless pods set it, in which case it overrides ENABLE_NATIVE_SIDECARS.

assertion.statement: A new pod annotation `sidecar.istio.io/native-side` (true/false) was added to control native sidecar injection per pod, taking precedence over the ENABLE_NATIVE_SIDECARS environment variable.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Purely additive opt-in annotation; the text states no environment condition under which anything breaks.
